[/p][p] Added[/p][list][*][p][b]In-game Guide[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You can now check Hounimal's basic rules from the pause screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/da1a3c562a499163134e9aa744cb26e158677bc5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Command List Display on Furniture Reward Screen[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You can now see what commands are available when choosing furniture rewards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/03ff097efef9639ce9f8fb6977bc0ebf837233a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Changed the description for "Triple Resonance Accel" and "Double Resonance Accel" to clarify they are permanent effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the description for the "House Breaker" debuff.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of Hounimal Furious Claws' companion spirit.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where controls would become unresponsive if a command reservation was canceled at a specific timing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some buff/debuff subtractions were not correctly applied only during boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Hounimals sometimes couldn't be selected at the Monument after returning to base from an adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rewards and shop inventory would change after "Book of Lore."[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the protagonist's back hair would clip into furniture.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hounimal Ver0.2.0 Update Released!
notes.notes: [p]Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience! The July 0.2.0 update, featuring a new Hounimal, has now been released! Check out the patch notes below![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Key Additions[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Hounimal "Furious Claws" & Facility "Monument with an Emblem"[/b] After clearing the second stage, you can select the Hounimal "Furious Claws" from the Monument. This Hounimal boasts a vertical layout and fights by transforming its rage into power.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Ceiling Furniture[/b] Easy to place in Hounimal's often-empty spaces, these furniture pieces don't add commands but offer powerful placement effects.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Command Reset Function[/b] Commands can now be reset after a CHAIN or after using Accel.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Stage "Tense"[/b] This is the fourth stage, featuring stronger enemies. It seems the Librarian will also lend a hand in your adventure. You might even meet the Saintess...[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Furniture Placement Effects[/b] Numerous effects have been added, including Command stat enhancements and buff acquisition upon drawing.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adventure Facility "Book of Lore"[/b] This facility alters adventure rules and difficulty in exchange for rewards like furniture and gold.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Base Facility "Forest Library"[/b] Here, you can view a list of your furniture. More information will be added in future updates.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Key Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Changed Command CHAIN Enhancement Description Rules[/b] Commands that previously activated additional effects at 2 or more CHAINS have been changed as follows: Old: "1 CHAIN or more" → New: "2 CHAINS or more" This change was made because the previous description was confusing; "X CHAINS or more" referred to the number of [i]activated[/i] commands, whereas "Xth CHAIN" referred to the Xth command [i]including unactivated ones[/i].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Other Additions & Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added icons for Command Additional Effect Rules.[/p][list][*][p]Now you can see how many CHAINS are required for an additional effect on the command itself.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added New Command Enhancement Rules.[/p][list][*][p]Commands are enhanced when "consuming HP while command is usable" or "Weight Accel is unused."[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved Map Generation Logic.[/p][list][*][p]The same block will no longer spawn enemies and rewards simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Simple conversations added within each NPC facility.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new disaster foes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 20 new furniture pieces (surpassing 100 total!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added 18 new commands (total for furniture, Hounimal, and enemies).[/p][/*][*][p]Added new NPC: The Saintess.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new achievements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Adjustments[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Base facility menu, transitions, background.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure facility background.[/p][/*][*][p]Base lighting, NPC positions, background.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff and debuff icon sizes.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility for placed/unenhancable furniture in the list.[/p][/*][*][p]Hounimal grid colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Out-of-Place Artifact \[Shop] operation position.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Hounimal evolution effect misalignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Placement effect enhancements not updating with placement reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Description of "Ignition."[/p][/*][*][p]Map names in achievement descriptions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Future Plans[/h3][p][/p][p]Before the planned September update, we intend to add the following highly requested features in the near future:[/p][list][*][p][b]In-game guide to review basic rules.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Command confirmation on the furniture selection screen.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]That's all for this update! It's been a while since the last Devlog, so we aim to post monthly updates going forward. If you have any bugs or requests, please don't hesitate to provide feedback![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Mini Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
The following changes have been implemented:

Additions
・Unique VFX for Pressure and Absorption
・Base Facility: Hero’s Proof
　 Emphasized claim button for completed achievements
　 Added guide for claim operation

Bug Fixes
・Furniture could be illegally upgraded despite insufficient funds
・Accel obtained via command effects was not randomized
・Furniture could be placed on Classic Closet and Ghost Closet
・Combat could start before the map was generated
・Debuff “Furniture Breaker” was not activating properly
・Enemy command Quick Battle Icon was disappearing before activation

Adjustments
・Adjusted Reward UI (added text explaining selection rules)
・Adjusted command order for Red Vine enemies
・Improved display and evolution effects for Hounimal’s third evolution stage

notes.title: Mini Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
The following changes have been implemented:

Additions
・FPS settings (default is set to 60fps)
・Size and rarity indicators added to the furniture mouse-over UI
・Added annotation regarding Continue on the pause screen

Bug Fixes
・Defeating an enemy with a CHAIN attack was not counting toward achievements
・Command type icons were not being reflected in furniture enhancement information
・Merchant’s bag display issue fixed
・Display issue with Hounimal’s third evolution stage resolved

Adjustments
・Adjusted placement of certain furniture items
・Adjusted position of some enemy death effects

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
The following issues have been fixed:
Resetting the layout caused the available space for placing furniture to shrink.
Maps beyond the current progress could be selected.
Canceling "Start from the Beginning" prevented it from being selected again.
Facility icons beyond the current progress were displayed.

notes.title: Early Access Release of "Hounimal" Scheduled for 2025
notes.notes:
Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,

We have news about the rogue-lite x housing RPG "Hounimal."

While we initially planned to release the store page for this work in September 2024, we have decided to adjust the schedule as follows to enhance and improve the final version.

-------------------------------
Scheduled for release in 2024
↓
Early Access beginning in Q1 2025
-------------------------------

We apologize for the change in release content and the short notice.

We are expanding the range of strategies compared to the initial content. Development is progressing smoothly, so please rest assured.

In Early Access, you will be able to experience the main game cycle. If you have any feedback after playing, please feel free to share it with us.

Lastly, we have updated the screenshots on the store page in line with this announcement! Please take a look if you're interested.
